notes.title: The Snail Trek series now available for MacOS and Linux
notes.content: I'm happy to announce that Snail Trek 1-4 are now available for MacOS and Linux! Enjoy!

notes.title: The story concludes with chapter 4 - Now available!
notes.content:
Here it is! Chapter 4 is longer and more challenging than the first three, I hope you really enjoy it :-).

http://store.steampowered.com/app/774531/Snail_Trek__Chapter_4_The_Final_Fondue/

Also, the four chapters are now a part of a "complete the set" bundle (not available in some countries) for an additional 25% discount.
